sentences.text: 3. As far as the present applicant is concerned, the allegation is that he has harassed the victim girl by informing her that he is having her obscene photographs in the mobile phone.
As far as the sexual assault is concerned, no allegation is made against the present applicant whatever reveals from the investigation papers.

4. Learned APP is requested to seek instructions regarding the availability of the analysis report on or before 24.06.2024.
5. Matter be placed before this Court on 24.06.2024.

Dated : 14/06/2024
1.
The application is for grant of bail.
2. The applicant is prosecuted for the offences punishable under Sections 354(a), 354(d), 376(2)(n),
376(d), 376(d)(a) and 506 of the Indian Penal Code, under Sections 4, 6, 11 and 12 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and Sections 67, 67(a), 67(b) of the Information Technology Act.
3. As far as the present applicant is concerned, the allegation is that he has harassed the victim girl by informing her that he is having her obscene photographs in the mobile phone.
As far as the sexual assault is concerned, no allegation is made against the present applicant whatever reveals from the investigation papers.
Now only fact which (2) 57.ba.407.2024 requires to be ascertained is whether really such photographs are stored in his mobile phone.
